name: statefall
description: Headless simulation tests and release tooling for Statefall

scripts.syntax: node tools/check-game-syntax.js && node --check playwright.config.js && node --check playwright.wordpress.config.js && node --check tools/package-zip.js && node --check tools/build-release.js && node --check tools/build-plugin.js && node --check tools/build-previous-plugin.js && node --check tests/build-package-fixtures.js && npm run syntax:prototype
scripts.test: npm run test:rendering-contract && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:engine && npm run test:engine-isolation && npm run test:relay && npm run test:adversarial-boundaries && npm run test:compatibility-effects && npm run test:world-loop && npm run test:command-router && npm run test:rules-geometry && npm run test:state && npm run test:map-generation && npm run test:world-setup && npm run test:match-flow && npm run test:diplomacy && npm run test:land-combat && npm run test:ai && npm run test:logistics && npm run test:economy && npm run test:structures && npm run test:missiles && npm run test:fog && npm run test:air && npm run test:naval && npm run test:simulation-ports && npm run test:harness-hardening && npm run test:help-contract && npm run test:browser-server && npm run test:security && npm run test:seeded-order && npm run test:replaycheck && npm run test:phase-d-parity && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:restart && npm run test:renderer-independence && npm run determinism
scripts.test:terrain-raster: node tests/terrain-raster-model.js && node tests/terrain-raster-client.js && node tests/phase-f1-source-evidence.js
scripts.test:runtime: node tests/sha256.js && node tests/strict-math.js && node tests/canonical-typed-cache.js && node tests/deterministic-runtime.js
scripts.test:rendering-contract: node tests/presentation-step-clock.js && node tests/classic-terrain-client.js && node tests/area-labels.js && node tests/rendering-contract.js && node tests/atlas-manifest.js && node tests/phase-e-hardware-harness.js && node tests/structure-layer-model.js && node tests/pre-structure-layer-model.js && node tests/naval-logistics-model.js && node tests/warship-layer-model.js && node tests/projectile-layer-model.js && node tests/missile-layer-model.js && node tests/aircraft-layer-model.js && node tests/map-label-layer-model.js && node tests/support-actor-layer-model.js && node tests/floating-text-layer-model.js && node tests/global-effects-layer-model.js && node tests/nation-overlay-layer-model.js && node tests/world-annotation-layer-model.js && node tests/notification-overlay-layer-model.js && node tests/interaction-overlay-layer-model.js
scripts.test:engine: node tests/checkpoint-origins.js && node tests/rollback-copy.js && node tests/engine.js
scripts.test:restart: node tests/restart-replay.js standard && node tests/restart-replay.js fog && node tests/restart-replay.js garrisons
scripts.test:visual:windows: npm run test:visual:map:windows && npm run test:visual:prototype:windows
scripts.verify:browser: npm run test:browser && npm run test:desktop-scale && npm run test:prototype
scripts.build:game: vite build && node tools/build-howto.js dist/howto && node tools/build-flags.js dist/flags.js && node tools/finalize-game-build.js
scripts.build:trailer: vite build --mode capture && node tools/build-howto.js .artifacts/trailer-dist/howto && node tools/build-flags.js .artifacts/trailer-dist/flags.js
scripts.build:artifacts: npm run build:release && node tools/build-plugin.js && node tools/build-previous-plugin.js && node tests/build-package-fixtures.js
scripts.verify:artifacts: npm run build:artifacts && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File sandbox/verify-artifacts.ps1
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run verify:browser
scripts.release:assets: node tools/build-howto.js pkg/howto && node tools/build-flags.js pkg/flags.js
